moments.title: Love Island UK Crowns Winners
moments.blurb: The 2026 series of Love Island UK concluded on Monday, July 27, with the live final revealing this year's winning couple after eight weeks of villa drama.

angles.name: Who won?
angles.copy: After a summer of love, laughs, and a whole lot of drama, who walked away with the crown and the cash in the Love Island UK 2026 final? Tell us your favourite couple!

angles.name: Post-final chat
angles.copy: Still recovering from the Love Island final? From Casa Amor chaos to declarations of love, what was your most unforgettable moment of the 2026 series?

moments.title: Wacken Open Air Rocks On
moments.blurb: The 35th edition of the legendary Wacken Open Air festival, featuring metal giants like Def Leppard and Judas Priest, continues until August 1st in Germany.

angles.name: Live from Wacken
angles.copy: Wacken Open Air is in full swing! If you're there, what's been your highlight so far? If you could be, which band are you running to see?

angles.name: Metal mood
angles.copy: Def Leppard, Judas Priest, In Flames... Wacken is delivering the goods! What's your ultimate metal anthem to get you through Thursday?

moments.title: Lollapalooza Kicks Off in Chicago
moments.blurb: Lollapalooza 2026 begins today in Chicago, bringing a massive lineup including Lorde, Charli XCX, The Smashing Pumpkins, and John Summit across four days until August 2.

angles.name: Chicago Calling
angles.copy: Lollapalooza is ON! If you're lucky enough to be in Grant Park, who's top of your must-see list today? Lorde, Charli XCX, The Smashing Pumpkins... decisions, decisions!

angles.name: Festival vibes
angles.copy: From pop to rock to electronic, Lollapalooza has it all this weekend. What's the one track you'd love to hear live at a festival right now?

moments.title: Camp Bestival Dorset Starts Today
moments.blurb: The family-friendly Camp Bestival Dorset kicks off today, July 30, running until August 2, with a mix of music, arts, and activities at Lulworth Castle.

angles.name: Family festival fun
angles.copy: Camp Bestival Dorset has arrived! Kicking off today with four days of family fun, music, and good times. What's your favourite family festival memory?

angles.name: Dorset calling
angles.copy: Sun's out, music's on! Camp Bestival Dorset is underway. If you're heading there this weekend, what are you most excited for?

moments.title: Radar Festival for Prog Fans
moments.blurb: Radar Festival, the UK's progressive music festival, begins tomorrow, July 31, and runs until August 2, offering a weekend for fans of intricate and heavy sounds.

angles.name: Prog rock weekend
angles.copy: Get ready, prog fans! Radar Festival kicks off tomorrow for a weekend of groundbreaking music. Which progressive rock or metal band is essential listening for you?

moments.title: Sidmouth Folk Festival Begins
moments.blurb: The renowned Sidmouth Folk Festival starts tomorrow, July 31, bringing a week-long celebration of folk music, dance, and song to Devon until August 7.

angles.copy: Sidmouth Folk Festival is back tomorrow! A week of incredible music, dance, and culture starts in Devon. Who's heading down for the festivities?

angles.name: Westcountry Folk
angles.copy: From tomorrow, Sidmouth comes alive with folk music! What's your favourite folk tune to get you in the mood for a summer festival?

moments.title: The Roots Picnic UK Debut
moments.blurb: The iconic US hip-hop festival, The Roots Picnic, makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9, featuring world-class hip-hop and R&B.

angles.name: Hip Hop in London
angles.copy: The Roots Picnic is coming to London next weekend for its UK debut! Get ready for two days of incredible hip-hop and R&B at Crystal Palace Bowl. Who are you hoping to see?

angles.copy: London, get ready! The Roots Picnic lands next weekend. What's your all-time favourite Roots track to get you hyped?
